verdict.rationale: Cake Equity is a SaaS cap-table platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no API reference, runnable examples, or developer portal, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The read-only MCP connector and the help-centre llms.txt are separate features and do not count toward an interactive API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
